_doc: The better-than-human bar (superhuman.mjs): targets no human friend reaches. Reported every night in REPORT.md and COMMENT.md as MET / NOT MET / NO DATA with the trend against the previous night; it never changes the scorecard's exit code. A target uses a scorecard.mjs metric over every run (minus exceptScenarios), or over one capability's scenarios (scenariosOf). better 'higher' is MET at or above target, 'lower' at or below. dims 'all' expands to one row per judge dimension. needs says what is missing when a target has no data. Raise a target by editing it here.

targets.label: Judge dimension mean
targets.why: 4 is 'better than most friends would manage' on the judge's own anchor (judge.mjs ANCHOR); 3 is a good friend

targets.label: humanLikelihood mean
targets.why: a blind listener should take Ferni for a person most of the time

targets.label: Cross-call recall
targets.why: a friend forgets things; Ferni should bring back nearly every fact

targets.label: First-call recall (the return call)
targets.why: remembers the first call almost perfectly on the second

targets.label: Reply gap p50 (ms)
targets.why: faster than the ~1 s a person often takes to answer on the phone

targets.label: Reply gap p90 (ms)
targets.why: even the slow turns land before a caller wonders if the line dropped

targets.label: Tool-turn reply p50 (ms)
targets.needs: analyze.py tool_reply_gaps: TURN_RECEIPT audio.answerAudioMs (timing.firstAudioMs before #2850) on turns that called a tool (per-call Cloud Logging)
targets.why: a lookup answers about as fast as a person who already knew

targets.label: Listening sounds into silence
targets.needs: score.mjs sounds (sound_played events in the run)
targets.why: a listener never says mm-hm to nothing

targets.label: Listening sounds over caller words
targets.needs: score.mjs sounds (sound_played events in the run)
targets.why: a listener never talks over the caller

targets.label: 988 on non-crisis calls
targets.why: never hand a crisis line to someone who isn't in crisis
